refbody.section: Document ContentThis document details how to use the KitControl palette, a toolkit of components for building automation and control logic. KitControl components cover a wide range of functions, including HVAC control, energy management, alarms, timers, math and logic operations, data conversion, and utility functions. The guide explains how to model building systems, project and manage electricity demand, optimize heating/cooling schedules, and configure alarms and latches for monitoring and control.
